BluetoothDeviceType
The Bluetooth device type. There are two device types - Classic (BR/EDR) and Low Energy (LE). The value is gathered when
the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
Values:
BTH_BR_EDR (0x01)
BTH_LE (0x02)
NONE (0x00)
BluetoothDeviceAddress
Bluetooth MAC address, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothDeviceAddressType
Bluetooth MAC address type, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
Values:
BTH_ADDR_PUBLIC (0x00)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM (0x01)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM_PRIVATE (0x02)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM_STATIC (0x03)
BluetoothVendorIdSource
The source for vendor ID, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
Values:
BTH_SIG (0x01)
USB_IMPL (0x02)
NONE (0x00)
DeviceVendorId

BluetoothDeviceName
The Bluetooth device name, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothDeviceModelNumber
The Bluetooth device model version, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothDeviceAppearanceValue The Appearance characteristic defines the representation of the external appearance of the device for Bluetooth Low
Energy (LE) devices. The value is gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothClassOfDeviceValue
The Class of Device defines the representation of the external appearance of the device for Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR)
devices. The value is gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothServiceName_1
The 1st service or profile name. The name is provided by the device when the device is paired or connected.

BluetoothServiceUuidArray
An array of service or profile UUIDs for devices with more than 8 UUIDs. If a device has more than 8 UUIDs in the
DcBluetoothDeviceProperties event then the 9th and following UUIDs are placed in the array. The names for these UUIDs
are not provided. Instead of these array, UUIDs might be reported with multiple DcBluetoothDeviceProperties events, each
event contains 8 or less UUIDs. The particular method to report UUIDs is defined by UUID discovery delays.
